title: Fall back to the next matrix row on a rate limit or error
lead: Owner 2026-10-20: when Codex is rate-limited or fails, the engine should fall back to the Claude row (matrix: Sol high then Sonnet medium). By hand, relay-call.sh falls back on a rate limit and the orchestrator picks the next row on an implementer error; the engine must do both. Depends on the Codex adapter.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- A rate-limited role retries on the next lineup row and the run records both.
- An implementer error picks the next row, not the same row.
- When no row remains the run stops with the reasons.
